messages.en: Hayeon, you didn't watch yesterday's live, did you..?
The one where you were cheating on me with Xinyu unnie?
I watched the whole thing.
Seriously, what's she doing?
Was she always like that with everyone?
You're the same.
Girls just naturally fall for me. ㅎ
She's just trying to make people jealous.
It's completely different.
Hayeon, you should do a live with Sohyun too. ㅋㅋ
I was planning to. ㅎ

messages.ko: 안그래도 소현언니랑 일본에서 오붓하게 방쓰니까 좋더라 ㅋ
messages.en: Actually, it was nice sharing a room with Sohyun unnie in Japan. ㅋ
Chaewon would burst into tears if she found out.
She'd probably cry her eyes out.
Seriously though, Kim Chaewon...
Want me to tell you something cute?
I went to the company today.
The unnies were taking a break from practice.
"The unnies are here!"
"Yay! Nice!"
I was saying that
while walking over,
greeting everyone,
and then...
Kim Chaewon was standing right next to me.
I seriously didn't see her.
Then she looked at me and said,
"Hey, Jeong Hayeon... why didn't you say hi to me?"
She actually said that.
Isn't that so cute?
She seriously likes me so much.
